Host David Scott explores his long history of mental illness and the privileged pressure cooker that shaped his downfall.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? His close friend, 24-year-old Nicholas Camfield. In a shocking twist, Camfield not only killed his victim by repeatedly striking him in the head, he also mutilated, scalped, and defiled his body over the course of days. In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer

Celeste Beard Johnson has done many television interviews, flashing a smile as she proclaims her innocence and pleads for sympathy. But she's never been questioned by David Scott. And this interview is unlike any that she's ever done. In this special episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott reveals the real Celeste - cunning, calculating, and deadly.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.
A college student's murder haunts a community for years; with the verdict just in, jurors, investigators and friends reveal new details.

programme.title: The John Wayne Story: The Early Years
programme.desc: Profile of John Wayne's early years in the movie industry.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated.

programme.title: Pioneer Justice
programme.desc: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. After two men turn up dead, a marshal named Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) arrives, along with his partner, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), to investigate. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element.

programme.title: The Desert Trail
programme.desc: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice.

programme.title: The Tioga Kid
programme.desc: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy.

programme.title: The Man From Utah
programme.desc: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger.

programme.title: Check Your Guns
programme.desc: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad).

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: Ambush Trail
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: The John Wayne Story: The Early Years
programme.desc: Profile of John Wayne's early years in the movie industry.

programme.title: John Wayne Behind-the-Scenes: Filming of Stunts, Chases, Fights, Crashes & Gun Battles
programme.desc: Rare production features, TV clips, and special promos provide a behind-the-scenes look at the stunts, fights, gun battles and chases from John Wayne movies including "Stagecoach," "War Wagon," "Brannigan" and "McLintock.".

programme.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday
programme.desc: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. But when one of Kindler's old German associates arrives unexpectedly in town, bringing in his wake a sly federal investigator, Kindler resorts to desperate measures to preserve his secret.

programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

programme.title: Oath of Vengeance
programme.desc: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel (William Post Jr.) from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte (Kaaren Verne), to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him.

programme.desc: When a number of attractive women are found dead and with fingers missing, Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) investigate. Though evidence points to a psychotic killer, Holmes begins to believe that there's more to the case than initially meets the eye, a notion that leads him to uncover the involvement of his archenemy, Professor Moriarty (Henry Daniell). Who is working with Moriarty on such a dastardly plot and what are their motives?

programme.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail
programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: Oath of Vengeance
programme.desc: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Bar 20 Justice
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.

programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. programme.title: The Charge of the Light Brigade

An inept chain of command and the arrogance of the aristocratic officers nearly destroys the brigade. Interpersonal wars within the unit, including unfaithful wives and a rivalry between Lord Cardigan and Captain Nolan (David Hemmings), heighten the conflict.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss

programme.title: Thunder Road
programme.desc: Unrepentant Tennessee moonshine runner Luke Doolin (Robert Mitchum) makes dangerous high-speed deliveries for his liquor-producing father, Vernon (Trevor Bardette), but won't let his younger brother Robin (James Mitchum) join the family business. Under pressure from both out-of-town gangster Kogan (Jacques Aubuchon), who wants a piece of the local action, and Treasury agent Barrett (Gene Barry), who wants to destroy the moonshine business, Luke fights for his fast-fading way of life.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: The Black Sleep
programme.desc: Victorian Sir Joel (Basil Rathbone) prepares for his wife's brain surgery by practicing on locals supplied by a Gypsy (Akim Tamiroff).

programme.title: The Mugger
programme.desc: A police psychiatrist lends his expertise to the hunt for a purse snatcher who leaves his victims with a facial scar.

programme.title: The Young Savages
programme.desc: After a Puerto Rican teen is murdered by three white adolescents, the case comes to Assistant District Attorney Hank Bell (Burt Lancaster). Realizing that he used to date the mother (Shelley Winters) of one of the suspects, he wonders if the boy is his son. Despite Bell's personal involvement, the district attorney (Edward Andrews) keeps him on the case. However, as Bell discovers street gang involvement in the case, he and his wife (Dina Merrill) begin to face physical threats.

programme.title: Witness to Murder
programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

programme.title: The Killer Is Loose
programme.desc: Humble bank teller Leon Poole (Wendell Corey) participates in a heist that doesn't go as planned. When police surround his apartment, there's a shoot-out, during which Detective Sam Wagner (Joseph Cotten) unwittingly kills Poole's wife. Poole is subsequently captured and jailed, but three years later he's back out on the street and hell-bent on revenge. Wanting the punishment to fit the crime, he vows that he won't kill Wagner -- just his wife (Rhonda Fleming).

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: An innocent ex-con becomes a two-time loser when he finds himself the scapegoat in the murder of a disreputable female.

programme.title: Three Bad Sisters
programme.desc: Following the death of a wealthy man, his three daughters squabble about who should be the principal heiress.

programme.title: A Hole in the Head
programme.desc: Based on Arnold Schulman's Broadway play of the same name, this comedy finds widower Tony Manetta (Frank Sinatra) struggling to own and operate a Miami hotel. Irresponsible in both business and romance, Tony is dedicated to his young son, Ally (Eddie Hodges), though he butts heads with his own brother, Mario (Edward G. Robinson). When Mario agrees to help Tony out financially, the catch is that the bachelor has to settle down and find a mother for his son.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: Three in the Attic
programme.desc: A campus swinger (Christopher Jones) keeps three girlfriends in the dark; they catch on and try to exhaust him.

programme.title: The Honey Pot
programme.desc: As an elaborate joke, the wealthy Cecil Fox (Rex Harrison) hires actor William McFly (Cliff Robertson) to play his personal assistant and invites three of his old flames, including Texan socialite Mrs. Lone-Star Crockett Sheridan (Susan Hayward), to visit him. Claiming to be on his deathbed, Fox has motives that remain unclear, and things take a surprising turn when one of the guests is found dead. As Inspector Rizzi (Adolfo Celi) investigates the crime, the plot of the mystery thickens.

programme.title: Corporate Affairs
programme.desc: A promotion to middle management causes a family man (Breckin Meyer) to become a slacker.

programme.title: Bikini Beach
programme.desc: Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon) are primed to hit the beach for some fun in the sun. The only thing standing in the way of their good times is curmudgeonly developer Harvey Huntington Honeywagon (Keenan Wynn), who is intent on turning their teenage hotspot into a grazing ground for seniors. If that weren't bad enough, British rock 'n' roll singer Potato Bug (also Avalon) shows up to spark a summer romance with Frankie's main squeeze -- Dee Dee.

programme.title: Three on a Spree
programme.desc: An Englishman (Jack Watling) inherits a fortune but must spend a million in 60 days, and prove it, to get it.

programme.title: It's a Pleasure
programme.desc: A figure skater's (Sonja Henie) boozing husband (Michael O'Shea) joins an ice show after being barred from hockey for life.

programme.title: Eight on the Lam
programme.desc: A widower with seven children, Henry Dimsdale (Bob Hope) is employed as a bank teller. After finding $10,000 on the street, Henry takes the money home, but quickly finds out that the cash came from his workplace. Soon Henry is on the run with his kids, while their baby sitter, Golda (Phyllis Diller), tries to throw her none-too-bright police officer boyfriend, Jasper Lynch (Jonathan Winters), off their trail. Amid the antics, Henry falls for pretty schoolteacher Ellie Barton (Shirley Eaton).

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Deadly Intent
programme.desc: An adventurer's boss (Maud Adams) and other villains want his widow (Lisa Eilbacher) to lead them to his South American jewels.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Diggstown
programme.desc: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down.

programme.title: Amazing Grace

programme.title: The Return of Sabata

The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit.

programme.title: The Mercenary

While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

Befriended by the kind Peggy (Patsy Kelly), Joan takes an assumed name and moves in with Peggy, then joins her working at Butterfield's department store. Bill, who has begun an article on Joan, visits the store and, recognizing her there, realizes that he has stumbled upon a hot story.

programme.title: Repent at Leisure

When she arrives in America, Dorothy switches places with her secretary, Sylvia (Fay Wray), to avoid the press. But after Dorothy's fiancé (George Meeker) proclaims his love for another woman, she wonders if any man can love her for more than her money. Still disguised as a secretary, Dorothy falls for Tony (Joel McCrea) and puts him through a series of tests to prove his affections.

programme.title: Bride by Mistake
programme.desc: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has.

programme.title: Sun Valley Serenade
programme.desc: As a surefire way to receive good press, bandleader Phil Corey (Glenn Miller) and his ensemble decide to adopt a war refugee. When it turns out that their adoptee isn't a child, but a pretty Scandinavian woman named Karen Benson (Sonja Henie), it leads to a flirtatious relationship with the group's pianist, Ted Scott (John Payne), who is already involved with singer Vivian Dawn (Lynn Bari). As the band heads to snowy Idaho for a gig, romantic drama, skiing, ice skating and musical numbers ensue.

programme.title: Orchestra Wives
programme.desc: When a touring swing band arrives in her small town, Connie Ward (Ann Rutherford) falls hard for trumpeter Bill Abbot (George Montgomery) and decides to marry him on a whim -- since the band is leaving as quickly as it arrived. Quite unprepared for her new lifestyle, Connie struggles to adjust to the constant travel from one town to another, and also to the pettiness of the other musicians' wives. Eventually, the marriage and the band break up, but Bill is determined to make it all right again.

programme.title: Birth of the Blues
programme.desc: Jeff Lambert (Bing Crosby), who has grown up in New Orleans surrounded by black music, determines to start a band featuring white cornet player Memphis (Brian Donlevy). However, the Basin Street Hotshots are rejected from several venues for playing "black" jazz, until singer Betty Lou Cobb (Mary Martin) insists they be hired as her backup band. The band finds success until Jeff and Memphis fall out over Betty Lou, then get entangled with gangster Blackie (J. Carrol Naish).

programme.title: Girl Crazy
programme.desc: Distracted by female students and performing poorly in the classroom, Danny Churchill Jr. (Mickey Rooney) moves west to a university that his father believes is free of temptation. Soon, though, Danny strikes up a friendship with Ginger Gray (Judy Garland). When Ginger, whose family runs the all-male college, explains that the school has money troubles, creative Danny puts together a big fundraiser. The event highlights their song-and-dance skills and also cements their bond.

programme.title: Strike Up the Band
programme.desc: Teenage drummer Jimmy Connors dreams of winning the contest for school bands hosted by popular band leader Paul Whiteman (himself). In order to enter, Jimmy and his pals, including charming vocalist Mary Holden, must accumulate $200 for the train ride to Chicago, where the contest will be held. Jimmy and his friends decide to put on an epic student play to raise the funds they need, but a sudden illness threatens to cost the band their chance.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band that constantly practices. Soon, Jimmy finds himself trying to help the band by getting them gigs and trying to reconcile the family with his uncle, an avid music-hater.

programme.title: God Is My Co-Pilot

Chennault, who commands the famous "Flying Tigers" squadron in China. Chennault finally allows Scott to learn combat flying techniques on an obsolete training plane. Scott is so good that Chennault gives him his wish -- he will fly combat missions with the Tigers.

Olcott's girlfriend, Rose (Arlene Dahl), gets jealous, suspecting an affair. But in spite of his relationship battles, Olcott's star rises with a series of ballads, including the title track.

programme.title: Slo Pitch
programme.desc: As Captain of the slo pitch beer league team, the Brovaries, Joanne is determined to make this season count, but the team just can't get their act together. Joanne's hot lawyer fiancé is so bad that kicking her off the team is the only solution. Stoner-bisexual Ann is sleeping with TWO members of the Brovaries' biggest rival team, and disgraced ex pro player Mel has sunk into a deep depression. If all that wasn't enough, German beer hound Boris needs to find a wife or face imminent deportation before playoffs, and rookie Lee spends more time with her glove on her head making Tik Tok videos than catching anything. The Brovaries need to come together if they're going to make it past the drama, save a marriage, fake a marriage, and beat their rival team, The Blue Gays. There may not be any money, trophies or sponsorship deals up for grabs, but for the Brovaries, slo pitch is life or death. Well, maybe for Joanne anyway. Everyone else is just in it for the beer. And the girls.

programme.desc: When their rivalry leaves them cast adrift on the streets of New York, two squabbling mutts must put their differences aside. Animated adventure.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Pets 2
programme.desc: Sequel to the hit film about the adventures of our pets that we don't see when we leave home. With the voices of Kevin Hart and Harrison Ford.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2
programme.desc: Bored of life in the garden, Peter goes to the big city, where he meets shady characters and ends up creating chaos for the whole family.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: After intercepting a cryptic radio message, intrepid Josh Hutcherson and stepdad Dwayne Johnson set off across the Pacific on a magical voyage of discovery. Flashing images.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When a stranger claims to be their long lost uncle, the Addams Family attempt to uncover the truth. Comedy with Christina Ricci. With comic violence and flashing images.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Sinister sequel fun as Uncle Fester falls for the fiendish family's suspicious new babysitter. Comedy with Anjelica Huston, with comic violence and flashing images.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fun comic adventure about a four-inch high family who fall foul of nasty lawyer John Goodman. Tom Felton - Draco Malfoy in the Harry Potter films - makes his acting debut.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Over the course of several lifetimes a loveable dog tries to figure out what it means to be man's best friend. Family drama with Dennis Quaid.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Li Fong relocates to New York City and attracts unwanted attention from a local karate champion. He embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition.

programme.title: The Spongebob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: SpongeBob and the gang leap into action when a pirate steals the secret recipe for Krabby Patties. Family adventure. Flashing images.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy and co try to return his new baby brother to the hospital in this fun animation. With the voices of Whoopi Goldberg and Busta Rhymes. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: It's cartoon chaos when the little terrors are marooned on an island with the nature-nutty Thornberrys. Messy fun with the voice of Bruce Willis.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse Of The Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: A giant crop-munching rabbit goes on the rampage. Can Wallace and Gromit save Tottington's vegetable contest? Oscar-winning animation.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Showstopping animation about a penguin who can't sing, but whose tap-dancing might just make him a star. Oscar-winning crowd-pleaser with Hugh Jackman and Nicole Kidman.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Pirouetting penguin Mumble is back, fighting to save his melting Antarctic home in this animation. With Elijah Wood, Brad Pitt and Matt Damon. Flashing images.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Fur flies as the kung fu cats of power-hungry Mr Tinkles battle for world domination against a pack of canine commandos. Animal antics. Mild violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Woody Allen leads the voice cast as a worker ant desperate to escape colony conformity and woo the beautiful princess. Sharon Stone also voices this animated adventure.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy about a youngster concerned that his baby brother is actually a power-hungry tycoon sent to destroy his perfect family life.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Fur flies as the kung fu cats of power-hungry Mr Tinkles battle for world domination against a pack of canine commandos. Animal antics. Mild violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge Of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: With a feline superspy plotting world domination, cats and dogs must put their rivalries aside to defeat her. Family fun. Mild violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Smash-hit comedy following a single mother on her search for the perfect husband and father to baby Mikey (voiced by Bruce Willis). With John Travolta. Strong language.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Roseanne Barr voices the new addition to Kirstie Alley and John Travolta's family, and is just as opinionated as her toddler brother, voiced by Bruce Willis. Comedy sequel.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Danny DeVito and Diane Keaton voice the new pets of couple Kirstie Alley and John Travolta, and their take on the world makes for some eye-opening insights. Sex references.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi and Boo-Boo must save Jellystone Park in this live action version of the classic cartoon. Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake voice the misbehaving bears.(78mins).

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: The Secret Ninja Force must form an uneasy alliance with the villainous Lord Garmadon when an even greater threat emerges.

programme.title: Shaun The Sheep The Movie
programme.desc: Shaun the Sheep has to head into the big city and rescue the Farmer when a mischievous plan gets out of control. Delightful Aardman animation.

programme.title: A Shaun The Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Shaun makes a new friend when an alien touches down, but a dangerous group set out to find him first. Fun animation.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A man and his dog are fused together to turn into Dog Man. They must stop a cat from cloning himself and creating an evil kitten.

programme.title: Cloudy With A Chance Of Meatballs
programme.desc: An inventor builds a machine that turns rain showers into food showers, but greed soon sends it spinning out of control. Delectable animation with the voice of Anna Faris.

programme.title: Cloudy With A Chance Of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Chaos ensues when a scientist discovers his invention, which turns water into meals, is creating animals made of food. Flashing images.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Alex the lion, Marty the zebra and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap Manhattan zoo for madcap Madagascar. Fun-filled cartoon antics from the makers of Shrek.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: Further fish-out-of-water antics as the zoo-reared pals crash-land on the mother continent. Family animation with the voice of Ben Stiller. Contains mild cartoon violence.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: All hell breaks loose when the monsters from RL Stine's bestselling books come to life. Horror-comedy with Jack Black. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2
programme.desc: Halloween lurches into life when a group of youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from an RL Stine book. Creepy comedy sequel.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Quvenzhane Wallis, Jamie Foxx and Cameron Diaz star in this adaptation of the classic musical about a foster kid taken in by a wealthy businessman. Flashing images.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The masked hero returns to face the Penguin, a grotesque crime boss dwelling in the sewers who conspires with a corrupt businessman to make himself mayor. When the tycoon tries to kill his secretary, she returns as vengeful vigilante Catwoman, who soon forms an intense relationship with the dark knight in both their costumed and real identities. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure sequel, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The masked crimefighter takes on the twin threats of disfigured maniac Two-Face and insane genius the Riddler, who are plotting to control the brains of the entire world. Meanwhile, an acrobat whose family has been murdered by Two-Face steps up to join Batman in his fight against evil. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Nicole Kidman, Jim Carrey and Chris O'Donnell.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The masked avenger stalks the streets of Gotham City, waging a nightly war against the criminal element. However, he may have met his match when the city's crime syndicate is taken over by the crazed Joker, who plans to poison the populace with toxic chemicals. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure, starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger.

programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In the near future, Australian cop Max Rockatansky tires of battling to impose law and order on the roads and turns in his badge - only to be forced out of retirement when his wife and child are murdered at the hands of a motorcycle gang. George Miller's action thriller, starring Mel Gibson, Joanne Samuel and Hugh Keays-Byrne.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: A former cop haunted by his tragic past roams the wasteland of Australia in the aftermath of a nuclear war. He arrives at a besieged settlement and grudgingly helps protect the residents from a horde of marauding bikers who want to get hold of their valuable supply of petrol. Futuristic adventure sequel, starring Mel Gibson, Bruce Spence, Vernon Wells, Emil Minty and Kjell Nilsson.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: The nomadic warrior pitches up in the city of a cut-throat desert community in search of his stolen vehicle and ends up making a deal with a local dictator to get rid of her rival for power. However, when the bargain turns sour, he is cast out into the wilderness - where he becomes the unlikely protector of a tribe of feral youngsters. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Mel Gibson, Tina Turner and Bruce Spence.

programme.title: Automoto
programme.desc: Présentée par Jean-Pierre Gagick, Automoto vous donne rendez-vous chaque dimanche au cœur de l'actualité automobile. Salons, courses historiques et événements populaires, l'émission est partout là où s'écrit la passion automobile. Sur sa base d'essai située sur le très secret circuit de Mortefontaine, Automoto teste les voitures de sport et met à l'épreuve toutes les nouveautés, sans concession ! Derrière le volant, vous retrouverez les pilotes historiques de l'émission comme Anthony Beltoise ou Bruce Jouanny, rejoints la saison dernière par Sarah Bovy. Côté motos, les habitués d'Automoto pourront également retrouver Bader Benlekehal. En parallèle, l'émission continuera de proposer une large diversité de sujets et de reportages : rubrique pratique, essais, comparatifs, sports mécaniques, vintage...

programme.title: Téléfoot
programme.desc: Grégoire Margotton et son équipe de consultants et chroniqueurs composée de Bixente Lizarazu, Rio Mavuba, Séverine Parlakou et Thomas Mekhiche vous donnent rendez-vous pour une nouvelle saison encore plus riche avec encore plus de Ligue 1 puisque 6 matches auront été disputés à l'heure de Téléfoot. Au programme : les résumés de 2 affiches, la nouvelle rubrique le Multiplex consacrée aux 4 rencontres du samedi soir, des reportages, des coulisses, des portraits et des interviews exclusives pour une couverture élargie et plus immersive de la Ligue 1. Cette saison,Téléfoot ira également au plus près de la saison des Bleus et de son nouveau sélectionneur, Zinédine Zidane.

programme.title: Grands reportages
programme.desc: En France, les arnaques en ligne ont bondi de 75 % en cinq ans. Près d'un internaute sur deux en aurait déjà été victime. Faux propriétaires d'appartement, faux conseillers bancaires, centres d'épilation peu scrupuleux, voitures au compteur trafiqué : des escroqueries sophistiquées, des sommes colossales, et des victimes qui refusent d'en rester là. Pendant plusieurs mois, une équipe a suivi quatre victimes dans leur combat contre les escrocs.

programme.title: Grands reportages
programme.desc: Chaque année en France, 70 000 personnes disparaissent "sans laisser d'adresse". Si la plupart sont retrouvées, environ 10 000 cas, soit plus de 30 par jour, restent non élucidés. Pour leurs proches, c'est un cauchemar. Bien souvent, ils doivent enquêter seuls pour comprendre pourquoi leur être cher s'est volatilisé ou pour renouer avec un membre inconnu de leur famille.

programme.title: Rugby : Championnat des nations

Elle est le portrait de la semaine d'Audrey Crespo-Mara.

À travers un grand tirage, les téléspectateurs ont la possibilité de se faire rembourser leurs courses, tout en (re)découvrant ce mode de consommation simple à intégrer dans le quotidien.

programme.title: La France a tout pour réussir
La France a tout pour réussir
La France a tout pour réussir
La France a tout pour réussir
Enquête exclusive
programme.sub-title: Forcenés, retranchés à domicile : la France qui craque
programme.desc:
En grande détresse économique, sociale ou familiale, ils se barricadent chez eux ou sur leur lieu de travail. Armes à la main, ces forcenés qui menacent leur entourage et refusent de se rendre sont aujourd’hui de plus en plus nombreux. Déjà près de trois-cent-cinquante en 2022, deux fois plus qu’avant la crise sanitaire ! Cette tendance à la hausse est-elle révélatrice du mal-être et des tensions qui rongent notre société ? 
La plupart de ces forcenés ne sont pas des malades mentaux mais des « Monsieur et Madame Tout-le-Monde ». Rien ne les prédisposait à la violence et pourtant, un jour, ils « pètent les plombs ». En grande majorité ce sont des hommes mais désormais on retrouve de plus en plus de femmes.
Grâce à des accords exclusifs avec le RAID et le GIGN, les unités d’élite de la police et de la gendarmerie, nos équipes ont pu filmer de l’intérieur les opérations de neutralisation de ces individus, aux côtés des négociateurs et des colonnes d’assaut.
Pour les cas les plus dangereux, policiers et gendarmes sont parfois obligés de déployer des moyens hors-normes, comme cet été dans un petit village des Landes, où un homme armé de vingt-et-un fusils de chasse a tenu tête au GIGN durant 44 heures ! Nous avons aussi retrouvé Christelle, une auxiliaire de vie du nord de la France. Avec cinq bouteilles de gaz, elle a voulu se faire exploser dans sa maison avec l’huissière venue l’expulser. Dans un témoignage exceptionnel, Christelle raconte comment elle s’en est sortie, indemne grâce aux négociateurs du RAID qui l’ont ramenée à la réalité. Nos équipes ont également suivi le père de Valentin Marcone, un employé d’une scierie qui, le 11 mai 2021, a tué son patron et un autre employé avant de se retrancher dans les montagnes des Cévennes, armé d’un pistolet automatique et d’un fusil à lunette. Désemparé, ce père ne comprend toujours pas ce qui a poussé son fils à se transformer en un meurtrier et un fugitif.
Quel est le mécanisme du passage à l’acte de ces forcenés et que deviennent-ils lorsqu’ils s’en sortent sans dommage ? Quel est aussi l’impact de leur geste sur leur entourage ? Y'a-t-il une prise en charge médicale, psychologique et sociale pour les aider à réintégrer la société après leur coup de folie ?
Des grandes villes aux campagnes, plongée bouleversante au cœur de la France des retranchés. Des citoyens souvent ordinaires qui, pour des raisons familiales, économiques, professionnelles, perdent le contrôle d’eux-mêmes et basculent, d’un coup, dans le monde des forcenés.

programme.title: Enquête exclusive
programme.sub-title: Luxe et démesure : camping-cars américains, le rêve sans limites
programme.desc: Aux États-Unis, pays de la démesure, le nouveau symbole de la réussite n'est plus le yacht ou la villa de rêve, mais le camping-car ! Les Américains les plus fortunés s'offrent des engins à plusieurs millions de dollars - marbre, équipements high-tech, et même cheminées : leurs rêves n'ont aucune limite. Les constructeurs profitent de l'aubaine pour concevoir des engins toujours plus innovants, tandis que les propriétaires de campings rivalisent d'imagination pour attirer cette clientèle en or.\r\nLa dernière tendance est de leur construire, à côté de leurs emplacements XXL, des villas de plusieurs centaines de mètres carrés, aussi onéreuses que leurs engins hors normes. L'assurance de se retrouver entre happy few, partageant la même passion dévorante pour les palaces sur roues.

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
programme.desc: De la Corse à l’Alsace, de l’Auvergne à la Provence, des dizaines de restaurateurs bien décidés à faire briller leur région vont accueillir chez eux les chefs Norbert Tarayre et Yoann Conte ! Leur but : partager et faire découvrir le plus typique, le plus gourmand, le plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.title: Brigade anonyme
programme.desc: Alia continue de recevoir des messages menaçants mais n’en parle pas à son père. De même, la juge Kohl tient volontairement Casta à distance de l’enquête tout en renforçant la surveillance d’Alia et en cherchant des points communs avec quatre autres affaires de disparition. Par ailleurs, la brigade est sollicitée par les parents de Romy, une influenceuse de 17 ans qui a été kidnappée contre rançon.

programme.title: Brigade anonyme
programme.desc: Quand la fille de Castaneda disparait, ce dernier comprend immédiatement la gravité de la situation. Les premières heures étant décisives et alors que le commissariat est en sous-effectif, il décide d'enquêter à sa manière : entouré de Nass, son meilleur ami, de Charlie, la surveillante scolaire du lycée d’Alia, et d’anonymes comme lui, sans passe-droits ni diplômes, ils vont sillonner la région pour traquer le ravisseur.

programme.title: Brigade anonyme

Il est alors sollicité par un père de famille, M. Balardi, fou d’inquiétude lorsque sa cadette, Stella, ne donne plus signe de vie, deux ans après la disparition de sa fille aînée. Castaneda va réunir les membres de sa brigade anonyme pour la retrouver….

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
programme.desc: De la Corse à l’Alsace, de l’Auvergne à la Provence, des dizaines de restaurateurs bien décidés à faire briller leur région vont accueillir chez eux les chefs Norbert Tarayre et Yoann Conte ! Leur but : partager et faire découvrir le plus typique, le plus gourmand, le plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

Pour les candidats, c’est donc le moment de sortir le grand jeu : oser, assumer ses choix et, si possible, donner au jury une bonne raison de les retrouver à l’étape suivante….

programme.title: Echappées belles
programme.desc: Il n'y a pas si longtemps, l'Albanie vivait sous l'un des régimes les plus fermés et oppressifs d'Europe. Aujourd'hui, la beauté naturelle et le dynamisme touristique semblent effacer peu à peu les traces de cette époque sombre, offrant aux visiteurs une vision d'une nation résolument tournée vers l'avenir.

programme.title: Nus et culottés
programme.sub-title: Objectif Hautes-Alpes : concerto pour un glacier
programme.desc: Nans et Mouts continuent leur route pour organiser un concert de piano au pied d'un glacier. Mais un tel rêve peut-il se réaliser sans argent ?

programme.title: Maghreb-Orient Express
programme.sub-title: Payram, Fanny Liatard, Jérémy Trouilh, Adel Fugazi, Baaziz
programme.desc: Contraint de quitter l'Iran, Payram questionne l'absence, la transmission et les liens intimes qui se construisent dans l'expérience de l'exil. Son exposition \" Que vos pas soient légers car vous marchez sur mes rêves \" est à voir à Paris. Avec \" Les Yeux verts \", Fanny Liatard et Jérémy Trouilh explorent les douleurs de l'exil. L'humour d'Adel Fugazi est à retrouver dans \" Le Temps d'une pause \". Baaziz se produit au Festival du monde arabe de Montréal.

programme.title: Démo de mode
programme.desc: Alexis Mabille revient sur son défilé haute couture automne-hiver 2024-2025, qui s'est tenu dans le cadre prestigieux du Lido.

programme.title: Partir autrement entre amis
programme.sub-title: Brienz, Suisse (Josée Deschênes et Élise Guilbault)
programme.desc: Les comédiennes Elise Guilbault et Josée Deschênes visitent le village alpin de Brienz, le domaine de Grandhotel Giessbach et la vallée de Lauterbrunnen.

programme.title: Le point
programme.sub-title: Noyer les gaz à effet de serre
programme.desc: En Nouvelle-Écosse, des scientifiques-entrepreneurs tentent de transformer les océans et les rivières en éponges géantes pour piéger et absorber les gaz à effet de serre.

programme.title: Mission info
programme.desc: C'est la rentrée et il faut reprendre les bonnes habitudes. \" Mission info \" s'intéresse cette semaine au sommeil. Comment se recaler alors que les horaires ont souvent été décalés pendant les vacances ? Comprendre les mécanismes en jeu permet d'adopter les bons gestes.

programme.title: Ça va l'faire !
programme.desc: Ça va l'faire ! compile le meilleur de la Riviera et de Monaco. Entouré de chroniqueurs, Sébastien Serrano présente l'actualité, les loisirs et les initiatives de la Principauté.

programme.title: Wari
programme.sub-title: Madagascar : le tsiperifery suscite le débat
programme.desc: A Madagascar, un poivre sauvage fait l'objet de toutes les convoitises. Le tsiperifery, une épice endémique de l'île, est particulièrement apprécié dans la gastronomie haut de gamme. Mais, victime de son succès et de la déforestation, cette ressource se raréfie. Face à cette situation, des entrepreneurs tentent de développer sa culture. Une perspective qui divise les exportateurs...

programme.title: Cousu
programme.desc: En Belgique, Karine Vanasse part à la rencontre de nouveaux designers de mode qui allient la sobriété et l'audace, les dignes héritiers des six d'Anvers.

programme.title: Le monde de Jamy
programme.sub-title: Santé, transports, climat : les animaux ont la solution !
programme.desc: Habitat, transports, éclairage : à l'heure du réchauffement climatique et des économies d'énergie, les animaux ont souvent la solution. Gros plan.

programme.title: Le monde de Jamy
programme.sub-title: Réchauffement climatique : nos produits du terroir vont-ils résister ?
programme.desc: Abricots du Roussillon, Tomme de Savoie, vins de Bourgogne : comment le réchauffement climatique affecte-t-il les produits du terroir ? Jamy Gourmaud enquête.

programme.title: Suisse en scène
programme.desc: Humoriste, chroniqueuse, stand-uppeuse, à la scène comme à la radio, Julie Conti distille un langage transgressif, engagé et volontiers provocateur, mélange de sarcasme, de bonhomie et d'humour qui désamorce des sujets sociaux et intimes, ancrés dans le quotidien et l'expérience personnelle...

programme.title: La Vigne en héritage
programme.desc: Avec environ 90 appellations, Joseph Drouhin propose une passionnante découverte du terroir bourguignon, dans toutes les nuances de son authenticité.

programme.title: Un pays, un livre
programme.desc: Paru en août 2016 aux Editions Grasset, "Petit Pays" est le premier roman de Gaël Faye, connu jusque-là comme auteur, compositeur et interprète.

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: Océane, créatrice de contenus franco-camerounaise, utilise les cheveux texturés afin de promouvoir la confiance en soi et l'affirmation identitaire.

programme.title: Hep taxi !
programme.desc: Humoriste et chroniqueuse, Doully s'est imposée comme l'une des voix les plus singulières du stand-up francophone. Elle se confie sur son parcours.

programme.title: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ?
programme.sub-title: Affaire Jacques Hyver : la belle, l'aventurier et le PDG
programme.desc: Le 28 juin 1980, en Charente, Michel Maury-Laribière, alors vice-président du CNPF et dirigeant d'une grande entreprise industrielle de tuiles et de briques, est kidnappé sur la route menant à son usine. Une demande de rançon de trois millions de francs est rapidement exigée.

programme.title: Meurtres à...
programme.desc: Au pied des montagnes du Béarn, l'épouse d'un notable est retrouvée noyée. La policière qui mène l'enquête doit gérer le divorce houleux de sa progéniture.

programme.title: La grande galerie francophone
programme.desc: Actrice, réalisatrice et écrivain, Sophie Marceau a tourné avec les plus grands. Aujourd'hui, elle publie "Warszawa", le récit intime de l'une de ses mille vies. Hervé Di Rosa, membre de l'Académie des beaux-arts, est le cofondateur du mouvement artistique de la figuration libre et du MIAM de Sète.

programme.title: La Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Top départ de la 13e édition de la Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe. Les 115 skippers prennent leur départ simultanément à 13h02, direction la Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Un pays, un livre
programme.desc: Paru en août 2016 aux Editions Grasset, "Petit Pays" est le premier roman de Gaël Faye, connu jusque-là comme auteur, compositeur et interprète.

programme.title: La Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Résumé quotidien de la Route du Rhum 2026 - Destination Guadeloupe, course transatlantique en solitaire qui relie, tous les quatre ans, Saint-Malo, en Bretagne, à Pointe-à-Pitre, en Guadeloupe.

programme.title: #Investigation
programme.desc: Au sommaire : IA, la fabrique à arnaques. Depuis le début de l'année 2026, les Belges sont la cible d'escroqueries en ligne. Ces plateformes de trading frauduleuses sont aujourd'hui la première source d'arnaque en ligne. - IA, confident mortel. Les agents conversationnels s'immiscent dans le quotidien.

programme.title: Mourir d'aimer
programme.desc: En mai 68, un lycéen de 17 ans s'éprend de son enseignante, professeur de français, une trentenaire contestataire : leur amour provoque un scandale.

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: Normande née à Granville, Johanna découvre le tango à New York : un coup de foudre qui la mène en Argentine. Elle tombe amoureuse du pays et de Maximiliano.

programme.title: Escapades en Suisse Italienne
programme.desc: Visite à l'école de sculpture de Peccia, où l'apprend à sculpter le marbre, puis descente à vélo jusqu'à La Botega, dont les produits frais viennent directement de la vallée.

programme.desc: Ce magazine met en lumière le dynamisme de la création francophone à travers des reportages dédiés à la haute couture, au design, à l'artisanat et à la gastronomie.

programme.title: Trouvez l'erreur
programme.desc: Il est facile de confondre les verbes apporter et emmener. À retenir : on \" emmène \" une personne et on \" apporte \" un objet.

programme.title: VF
programme.sub-title: Le musée des Peintres de Barbizon
programme.desc: Installé dans l'ancienne auberge Ganne, le musée des Peintres de Barbizon, retrace l'histoire d'un lieu d'émulation artistique au XIX? siècle. Ce village, refuge des peintres paysagistes et réalistes, célèbre la pratique du plein air et la nature représentée comme sujet principal.

programme.title: Tendance XXI express
programme.desc: Mode, artisanat, design, beauté, cuisine, art de vivre... les meilleurs moments de \" Tendance XXI \" ! Commentaires : Viviane Blassel.

programme.title: Un pays, un livre
programme.desc: \" De l'inconvénient d'être né \" d'Emil Cioran.

programme.title: Construire demain
programme.desc: Laurelle et Alexis installent des fenêtres performantes. En Estrie, Olivier, Sabrina et Denise posent des panneaux solaires sur leur maison écologique.

programme.title: Ça commence aujourd'hui
programme.sub-title: Ils ont choisi de ne pas avoir de relations sexuelles
programme.desc: Ils ont choisi de ne pas avoir de relations sexuelles Pendant longtemps, la sexualité a été considérée comme un pilier incontournable de la vie amoureuse. Mais aujourd'hui, les repères évoluent. Selon une étude de l'Ifop menée en 2026, les 15-29 ans accorderaient moins d'importance à la sexualité que leurs aînés. Alors, peut-on s'aimer sans faire l'amour.

Le rap féministe peut-il tout changer ?

Karambolage

programme.desc: Le mariage est un moment sacré et symbolique dans la vie des futurs mariés. Cristina Cordula sait à quel point la robe est l'un des éléments les plus importants de cette cérémonie. En effet, dans l'imaginaire collectif, la fameuse "robe de princesse" doit être parfaite, mais à chaque femme sa définition. Ainsi, plusieurs futures mariées se lancent à la recherche de LA robe de leurs rêves pour parfaire le plus beau jour de leur vie.

programme.title: Sphère5
programme.sub-title: Rebecca Royer - Violences sexuelles : on sait, alors qu'est ce qu'on attend pour agir ?
programme.desc: Et si enfin on prenait le temps de penser plutôt que de réagir ? Dans un paysage saturé de prises de parole rapides et formatées, SPHERE5 propose une alternative rare : des conversations longues, profondes et sincères autour des grandes questions de notre époque. Ophélie Meunier et Carole Juge-Llewellyn ont imaginé et créé ce programme ensemble. Chaque conversation est préparée sur mesure, afin de créer un échange profond et sincère.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: Lucy et Lynton sont propriétaires d'un appartement à East Grinstead. Alors que Lucy l'adore, Lynton le trouve trop petit et compte sur les idées de Kirstie.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: Karyn rêve d'une maison plus grande, tandis que Duncan apprécie toujours autant le charme rural de leur environnement actuel, et la rivière au bout de l'allée.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: La famille Charles n'arrive pas à décider si elle veut garder sa maison de trois chambres à Birmingham. Richard pense que leur maison est en parfait état, et que ce qui n'est pas cassé n'a donc pas besoin d'être réparé, mais Carla la déteste.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: Kirstie et Phil vont à la rencontre de James et Graham, qui n'arrivent pas à se mettre d'accord sur l'avenir de leur cottage du XVIIe siècle à Cranleigh, dans le Surrey.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.sub-title: Rapt parental : Camille, 5 ans, portée disparue
programme.desc: Février 2022, sur les bords du lac Léman. C'est à la faveur d'un simple contrôle routier que va se résoudre l'une des affaires les plus mystérieuses de ces dernières années. Alors qu'elle est recherchée depuis 2011 pour l'enlèvement de sa fille Camille, âgée de 5 ans, Priscilla Majani est arrêtée par la police suisse.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.sub-title: Disparition de Leslie et Kévin : le jeu trouble du meilleur ami
programme.desc: Mystérieusement disparus fin novembre 2022 après avoir dîné chez un ami près de Niort, Leslie et son petit ami Kevin sont retrouvés sans vie début mars 2023, à une cinquantaine de kilomètres de là. Les proches de la jeune femme, parents et amies, ont accepté de raconter les semaines d'angoisse qui ont précédé la découverte des corps.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.sub-title: Meurtre chez les gens du voyage
programme.desc: Dans la nuit du 14 février 2016, au sein d'un camp des gens du voyage, Raynald Barguet, 23 ans, est réveillé par un mystérieux appel. A l'autre bout du fil, une voix lui demande de sortir de sa caravane immédiatement. A peine dehors, le jeune homme est mortellement touché d'une balle en pleine poitrine. L'enquête révèle qu'une rivalité sentimentale serait à l'origine de l'assassinat.

programme.title: César Wagner
programme.desc: Un jeune homme est retrouvé mort, affublé d'un authentique uniforme SS. Cet étudiant effectuait des recherches sur "l'Or du Rhin", un trésor nazi mythique.

programme.title: César Wagner
programme.desc: A Strasbourg, un doigt est découvert dans une des bouteilles destinées à la dégustation pour le concours de la meilleure bière d'un festival très populaire.

programme.title: Cassandre
programme.desc: Cassandre mène une enquête pour le moins complexe sur la mort d'un jeune homme, qui semble avoir été commis par un quinquagénaire sans aucun mobile.

programme.title: Cassandre
programme.desc: Florence Cassandre mène l'enquête pour élucider le meurtre d'une jeune femme, survenu à l'endroit exact d'un crime similaire commis dix ans plus tôt.

programme.title: Cassandre
programme.desc: Cassandre et son équipe interviennent dans une prise d'otages au palais de justice. Il leur faut trouver une solution dans les douze heures à venir.

programme.title: Vous les femmes
programme.desc: Judith Siboni et Olivia Côte décrivent les coulisses, pas toujours assumées, du quotidien des femmes d'aujourd'hui. Elles dressent, en solo ou duo, une galerie de personnages féminins aux prises avec des situations banales, en mettant à mal l'image de la fille sexy, romantique ou parfaite….

À travers 4 époques - l'An 1 et les périodes Jeanne d'Arc, Louis XIV et Napoléon - revivez l'Histoire de France par le biais de ceux qui auraient mérité d'être connus… ou pas !

programme.desc: Un homme, passionné par son métier et qui ne s'est pas beaucoup occupé de son fils, apprend qu'il a été enlevé. Il va tenter de le retrouver.

programme.title: Le Jardinier
programme.desc: Un haut fonctionnaire proche du président de la République se retrouve malgré lui au coeur d'un secret d'Etat. Son nom apparaît sur une liste de cinq personnes à abattre.

programme.title: Le double expresso RTL2
programme.desc: Pour un réveil dynamique et tout en musique, Grégory et Justine vous offrent une double dose de son Pop-Rock, d'infos et de bonne humeur.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Ve siècle, île de Bretagne. Le royaume de Kaamelott s'organise autour de son souverain, le roi Arthur. Entouré de ses fidèles chevaliers de la Table Ronde, il s'attelle à la mission que les dieux lui ont confiée : rechercher le Saint Graal !

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'épouse et la maîtresse d'un Marine s'accusent mutuellement de son meurtre, obligeant le NCIS à découvrir laquelle ment. De son côté, Anthony DiNozzo Sr. est abordé par une jeune sans-abri persuadée qu'il est son père. Avec l'aide de Tony, il cherche à percer le mystère de son identité.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Des maîtres-chanteurs usurpent l'identité de Tony DiNozzo pour extorquer plusieurs sénateurs. Lorsque l'un d'eux est retrouvé mort, le NCIS remonte jusqu'au cerveau de l'opération, dont les motivations pourraient être liées au passé sentimental de Tony.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Une gardienne de prison britannique est retrouvée morte dans un conteneur arrivé d'Angleterre. Les premiers éléments indiquent qu'elle a été prise en otage par deux évadés, dont un ancien espion du MI6 autrefois arrêté par le NCIS.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S13 E22 - Sur tous les fronts
programme.desc: Après la mort d'une figure historique du NCIS, Vance et Fornell se rendent en Grande-Bretagne pour protéger l'ancienne directrice du MI6, elle aussi menacée. Pendant ce temps, Gibbs et son équipe viennent en aide à la famille d'un Marine dont le fils de 14 ans a repoussé un cambrioleur.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le NCIS, le FBI et le MI6 poursuivent leur traque de l'espion britannique Jacob Scott. Alors que Fornell lutte pour survivre et que deux anciens agents du NCIS sont à leur tour menacés, Gibbs découvre que Scott recherche également Ziva.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S14 E21 - Le droit à l'erreur
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'un Marine lié à un gang de motards contraint Torres à replonger dans une ancienne mission d'infiltration. Pour faire avancer l'enquête, il doit révéler à Gibbs un secret qu'il gardait enfoui depuis cette époque.

programme.title: Les apprentis aventuriers
programme.sub-title: S9 E42 - La Ruée vers l'or
programme.desc: La chasse aux coffres commence dans la jungle ! Les Roses, les Oranges et les Bleus cherchent la perle d’or, entre trouvailles, découragement et désaccords. Restés sur la plage, Benoît et Manon organisent leur quotidien avec humour.
